item.0: Oops, you lost the photo of the previous Roly-Poly? Well, then you just have to go back to Roly-Poly 5 and take another photo. Now I've got to get back to work!

quest.0: Hello! As you can see, I help repair Eos Tower! Oh, #b#p2040015##k sent you here? Hmm, then I think you should visit Roly-Poly 5 on #b#m221021800##k first.

lost.0: Oh no... Did you lose the picture you took with me? We'll have to take another one, then. Please make sure not to lose the picture this time around. Alright, here's a million-dollar pose of me working hard.
